BrokerApiKeyAuth.description: Broker API key, sent as a bearer token and accepted only by the QuickSwap broker API. The broker API key is a server credential. Call this API from the broker's backend, never from a browser or mobile app. The broker's members create, rotate and revoke keys through the QuickSwap broker API, and a key may rotate itself.

get.description: List the security and activity events of the caller's main account and all its sub-accounts in one feed, newest first. Only the main account's own session, or an API key with READ_ACCOUNT_ACTIVITY, may call it. A key scoped to a sub-account reads only that sub-account's events.

parameters.description:
API key (opaque ID) whose actions to return: only events performed with
 that key. Omit it to match every actor.

Public ID, as a base58 string.

 the caller may not read fails the request with NotFound.
